story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by altruists and egoists. Altruists always tell the truth, and egoists always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Benjamin, and Lucas. Benjamin remarked, "Lucas is an altruist". According to Lucas, "Benjamin is an altruist or Benjamin is an egoist". So who is an altruist and who is an egoist? (Format your answer like: "Benjamin is a altruist/egoist, and Lucas is a altruist/egoist")

options: Benjamin is an egoist, Lucas is an egoist
Benjamin is an egoist, Lucas is an altruist
Benjamin is an altruist, Lucas is an altruist
Benjamin is an altruist, Lucas is an egoist
